description: Free — this call never consumes credits or quota. Returns the credit balance, this month's quota usage, the per-second rate limit, and the full price list for every capture option. Call this before a large run to budget it, and after a 429 to find out whether you were rate limited (retry in a second) or are out of credits (do not retry).
name: domscout_check_credits
title: Check credit balance and pricing
